seen={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(a) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8}
stack=list(seen)
while stack:
 r,c=stack.pop()
 for nr,nc in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
  if 0<=nr<len(a) and 0<=nc<len(a[0]) and a[nr][nc]==0 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
   seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
out=[[8 if (r,c) in seen else v for c,v in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(a)]
print(out)
